adr: ADR 0012 Q0h — a tuning artifact, not a hand-typed code table
question: Community report (unconfirmed): gpt-5.6-sol rejects function tools combined with reasoning_effort on chat completions. ppxai is chat-completions-shaped for OpenAI, so this would break tool calling.
finding: The report is WRONG IN THE DIRECTION THAT MATTERS. It is not sol-only and it is not tools+effort: sending tools ALONE already 400s, on all three 5.6 models, with no reasoning_effort in the request at all. The 5.6 line evidently defaults to a non-'none' effort, so the caller does not have to ask for reasoning to hit it.

error.message: Function tools with reasoning_effort are not supported for gpt-5.6-{sol,terra,luna} in /v1/chat/completions. To use function tools, use /v1/responses or set reasoning_effort to 'none'.

reasoning_effort_none.cost: Disables reasoning on models sold FOR reasoning. Buying a reasoning model and pinning effort to none is close to buying the wrong model.

responses_wire.note: ppxai already speaks this wire (ADR 0012 W2), and openai_native already routes per model on wire_protocol. This is a table row, not new code — which is the outcome ADR 0012 was built to make possible.

recommendation: If the 5.6 line is configured, give each model wire_protocol='responses'. It is the remedy OpenAI's own error message lists first, it costs nothing measured, and it needs no code. Pinning reasoning_effort='none' is the fallback and should be a stated row decision, not a default.
not_configured_today: No 5.6 model is in ppxai-config.example.json, so nothing is broken right now. This artifact exists so the swap decision is made with the hazard measured rather than discovered afterwards.
